skills.title: What inhabits my mind
skills.mind: Regarding the mind, I lean towards an emergentist stance, where mental properties arise from the complexity of the brain and cannot be reduced to its parts. About being, I follow the ideas of Alain Badiou, seeing being as a process in constant change, always in relation to the event.
skills.ethics: Ethically, I am influenced by Jean-Paul Sartre, adopting an existentialist perspective in which each individual is fully responsible for their actions and must find meaning in their freedom. Aesthetically, I align with Immanuel Kant, seeking the aesthetic experience as something universal but deeply personal.
skills.study: I spend much of my time exploring and studying ontologies and scientific knowledge. I firmly believe that philosophy and science are not opposites, but fields that complement each other to better understand reality.
